summary: Fully read; corrected CNI configuration, prefix/Pod security-group behavior, CoreDNS capacity, load-balancer ownership and reproducible policy/IPAM exercises; 15 paired questions locally validated.
findings: Replaced fictitious Linux CNI ConfigMap keys and ENABLE_NETWORK_POLICY with actual add-on JSON/Helm/environment configuration; scoped default CNI and policy behavior to supported compute.
Corrected IPv4 secondary-address/prefix capacity and maxPods limits; prefix delegation can coexist with Pod security groups but does not enlarge total subnet address space or branch-ENI density.
Distinguished same-node traffic from VPC fabric/Flow Logs; removed universal no-overlay performance guarantees.

Corrected CoreDNS ownership, DNS records and cache examples. Upstream 1.14.7 accepts denial 1000 but released cache source normalizes it to 1024; explicit 1024 preserves effective capacity. success 10000 becomes 9984.
Corrected trunk/branch ENIs and cluster-role ownership; documented actual SGP mode, instance and SNAT constraints.
Replaced legacy CLB/default-public claims with explicit LBC NLB/ALB ownership and internal scheme; corrected IP targets, node ports, annotations, TLS logs and current QUIC protocol support.
Replaced undefined/bare Pod ICMP tests with namespace-owned controller Pods, scoped DNS, four TCP baseline paths, positive controls and UID-guarded cleanup. Policy direction/additivity explained.
Removed unsafe overlay cutover and fake FargateProfile API; corrected stable zone labels, custom-network prerequisites, CIDR reconciliation and hardware MAX_ENI bounds.
Preserved original up-to-five-times density statement as an unverified estimate, not a measured result or guarantee; no benchmark execution invented.
Retained all ten original topics and added five VPC foundation checks; repaired Korean headings/escaping and kept code paired.
validation: Read every original line (1–1069); original SHA and complete ranges recorded in progress.json.

Paired static validation: 18 Bash blocks, 18 native Kubernetes objects, 4 vendor specifications, 10 JSON fragments; 15 questions/10 multiple-choice answers per locale. Two real CLI input-skeleton checks; embedded Python syntax and scoped git diff --check pass.
Thirteen mocked shell cases verify policy-lab flow and UID cleanup; these do not execute network-policy enforcement.

Rendered VPC CNI 1.23.0 in three configurations (5 native objects each), checking actual environment and policy-agent arguments; rendered LBC 3.5.0 (9 native objects plus a List) with explicit region/VPC/service account. Vendor CRDs/List not fully schema-validated; optional null core fields omitted for v2 schema checks.

Actual checksum-verified CoreDNS 1.14.7 accepted both original denial 1000 and explicit 1024; both answered local DNS queries on 127.0.0.1:10555. Capacity normalization derived from released source, not measured heap allocation.

No AWS mutations, cluster installation, live policy enforcement or production validation. Evidence: /tmp/eks-networking-part1-audit/{quiz-static-validation,policy-flow-validation,controller-render-validation,cache-validation}.json.
